results.remarks: Welcome to a true backyard paradise in the heart of Corona! From the moment you arrive, this incredible home makes a lasting first impression with its charming front porch, elegant custom wood entry door, and inviting curb appeal. Step inside and discover a spacious home designed for both comfortable living and unforgettable entertaining. Inside, you’ll find soaring ceilings, abundant natural light, and an open-concept floor plan that flows beautifully throughout the home. The upgraded kitchen is the perfect gathering place for family and friends, while large windows showcase stunning views of the backyard oasis. The backyard is truly the crown jewel of this property — your very own private resort! The magnificent rock-accented pool and spa create a luxurious atmosphere that feels like a vacation every single day. Imagine relaxing in the spa as you watch breathtaking sunset skies light up the evening, or hosting unforgettable summer pool parties in this entertainer’s dream yard. The expansive covered & lattice patio provides an incredible amount of shaded outdoor living space, perfect for outdoor dining, family gatherings, game nights, and year-round entertaining. And for those 4-legged friends of ours Welcome to the Bark Park! ??Tucked away for residents-only. Designed with safety as a top priority, this fully fenced haven features a secure double-gated entry, allowing your pup to roam and race completely off-leash. To keep playtime stress-free, the park offers distinct, dedicated zones for both large and small dogs. Plus, we’ve got you covered on the essentials enjoy on-site water fountains, shaded seating to relax in, and complimentary waste bags. It’s the ultimate neighborhood spot for happy tails and tired paws.

results.remarks:
This pristine, recently built solar-powered single-family home—complete with a storage battery and EV charging—offers modern living with no common walls in the tranquil, gated Bedford community in the heart of South Corona.

Situated on a premium corner lot, the home enjoys abundant natural light, exceptional privacy with no neighboring homes intruding on sightlines, and one of the largest professionally designed backyards in the community. The outdoor space features high-end pavers, matching stone walls, lush plantings, partial artificial turf, and elegant pathway and landscape lighting—creating a serene retreat both day and night. Its southwest orientation brings warm, natural light into the living room, kitchen, loft, and other living spaces throughout the day.

Inside, the meticulously designed two-story layout showcases an airy open-concept kitchen and living area with contemporary finishes, a large quartz island, designer pendant lights, and quartz countertops. Soaring 9-foot ceilings on both floors enhance the home’s spacious, comfortable feel.

Upstairs, you’ll find three bedrooms plus a generously sized loft with panoramic green hilltop views—an ideal space for entertainment, relaxation, or flexible use.
The home includes numerous upscale touches: luxury vinyl plank flooring on the first floor, plush wall-to-wall carpeting in the bedrooms and loft, and ceramic tile flooring in the bathrooms and laundry room. A high-end GE washer and dryer, recessed and dimmable lighting throughout, convenient upstairs laundry, ceiling fans with dimmable LED lights, and newly installed custom window coverings (including automated shades in the loft) add comfort and convenience.
Additional features include two single-car garages, a full solar system with battery storage for significant energy savings, EV charging capability, a tankless water heater, and a fire-safety sprinkler system. The kitchen comes fully equipped with nearly new appliances, including a refrigerator, range/oven, and built-in microwave.
The Bedford community offers exceptional amenities, including two clubhouses—The Hudson House and The Shed—just a short walk away. Enjoy outdoor dining, a resort-style pool, spa, children’s pool, parks, playgrounds, a dog park, and scenic walking trails. Families benefit from highly rated local schools.. Come enjoy the Bedford life style, like being on vacation all the time!

results.remarks:
Framed by the majestic mountains of Temescal Valley, this beautifully appointed single-story residence presents an exceptional blend of sophistication, comfort, and resort-inspired living within Trilogy at Glen Ivy, a prestigious gated 55+ active-adult community.An impeccably maintained façade and thoughtfully landscaped grounds create an inviting first impression. Inside, approximately 1,966 square feet of light-filled living space unfolds with an effortless sense of warmth and refinement. Rich flooring, crown molding, high ceilings, and abundant natural light establish an elegant yet comfortable atmosphere throughout.Designed for both everyday enjoyment and memorable entertaining, the beautifully updated kitchen serves as the heart of the home. White cabinetry, expansive stone countertops, stainless-steel appliances, a distinctive backsplash, and a generous center island combine timeless style with exceptional functionality. The open design flows naturally into the dining and family areas, where a fireplace provides an inviting focal point.The spacious primary suite offers a tranquil private retreat with a dual-sink vanity, oversized glass-enclosed shower, and walk-in closet. A comfortable secondary bedroom welcomes guests, while the separate office with custom built-in cabinetry provides an inspiring setting for work, reading, or creative pursuits.Outdoors, a thoughtfully designed patio celebrates Southern California living at its finest. A graceful pergola provides shade and architectural character, while the built-in cooking and barbecue area creates the perfect setting for open-air dining against a backdrop of mountains and expansive skies. From peaceful morning coffee to sunset gatherings with friends, this is a space designed to be enjoyed.
The finished two-car garage further enhances the home with extensive storage cabinetry and additional room for the equipment that accompanies an active lifestyle.Residents of Trilogy at Glen Ivy enjoy controlled access and an impressive collection of resort-style amenities, including indoor and outdoor pools, a spa, fitness facilities, an indoor walking track, tennis, pickleball and bocce courts, social spaces, and a dynamic calendar of activities. . More than a residence, 9251 Hughes Drive is an invitation to live beautifully—with comfort, connection, and the natural splendor of the surrounding landscape.

results.remarks: This is a uniquely designed Plan 2,537 square foot home with a Spanish façade that features the primary bedroom with ensuite, a guest bedroom with full bathroom, and the laundry room all downstairs!  A wide entry leads to an open concept floor plan with a Great room that flows to the dining area and island kitchen with Quartz counter tops, a full backsplash, stainless steel appliances, and a pantry closet. The laundry room is conveniently located just behind the kitchen.  The downstairs primary bedroom comes with a walk-in closet and dual vanity sinks in the bathroom. Upstairs there is a large Bonus room, 3 bedrooms (one with a walk-in closet) and a full bathroom. There is white shaker-style cabinetry and blinds window treatments throughout and upgraded laminate in main living areas and carpet in the bedrooms, closets, stairwell, and Bonus room. This truly modern home has all the Smart Home features you would expect, solar is installed, and a direct-access 2-car garage pre-plumbed for an electric car. The front yard is fully landscaped and irrigated. The community is nearby local shopping, dining, entertainment, and freeway access. This home is anticipated to be ready for move-in mid-June 2026.

Upstairs, you'll find 3 additional bedrooms, a full bathroom, and a spacious loft perfect for a home office, second living area, playroom, or media space.
The main level offers an inviting living room, dining area, updated kitchen, and guest bathroom, all thoughtfully renovated and move-in ready.
Step outside and enjoy multiple outdoor living spaces, including a beautiful front patio with gorgeous mountain views—the perfect place to relax with a cup of coffee, take in the scenery, and enjoy stunning sunsets. The home also features a huge backyard, spacious front yard, large driveway, and a 2-car garage.A rare opportunity to own a beautifully updated home in one of Corona's most sought-after neighborhoods.

Conveniently located near the 15, 60, and 91 freeways, as well as parks, recreation, shopping, dining, entertainment, and schools. This turnkey home is a must see, don’t miss the opportunity to make it yours!

Offering the perfect combination of comfort, convenience, and long-term livability in one of Corona’s most desirable and established communities. One of the standout features is the large, private backyard, offering an abundance of space and endless possibilities. Whether you envision building a pool, creating an outdoor entertaining area, designing a beautiful garden, or simply enjoying plenty of room for family gatherings, this backyard gives you the opportunity to create the outdoor space of your dreams.  Enjoy the added benefits of low property taxes, no HOA, along with access to highly regarded Corona-Norco schools. The location is exceptionally convenient, with shopping, dining, parks, schools, and major commuter routes and freeways all nearby.  With comparable homes in the area selling for significantly higher prices, this is an exceptional opportunity to own a highly desirable single-story home in Corona at an attractive value.  Don’t miss your opportunity to make this wonderful home yours!

results.remarks:
Welcome home to a beautifully built 5-bedroom, 3-bathroom residence offering the perfect blend of modern luxury, incredible energy efficiency, and resort-style community living in Corona.

Step inside to discover an entertainer’s dream layout. The heart of the home is a gourmet kitchen featuring sparkling granite countertops and a massive custom 6-seat center island that flows seamlessly into the main living spaces. You can cozy up by the gas fireplace in the living room or enjoy immersive movie nights with a built-in surround sound system and hidden wiring throughout all living areas for a sleek, wireless look. This floor plan was designed with supreme functionality in mind, boasting a highly sought-after DOWNSTAIRS BEDROOM AND FULL BATHROOM—perfect for guests, multi-generational living, or a private home office. Everyday convenience is further maximized by a large, dedicated laundry room complete with ample built-in storage.

This home is a true powerhouse of energy efficiency and smart upgrades. Enjoy massive savings on your utility bills with the fully PAID OFF SOLAR system, a whole-house fan to keep things cool, and a tankless water heater. Step outside to your own vibrant, farm-to-table backyard retreat. Homes with this level of self-sustaining upgrades and premium amenities do not last long.

results.remarks:
Welcome home to 25003 Rockston Drive! Ideally situated on a corner lot with beautiful views in the highly sought-after Terramor master-planned community, this exceptional home offers the perfect blend of style, functionality, and comfort.

Featuring a high-powered solar system, custom paint throughout, a welcoming open-concept floor plan, and a downstairs office/bonus room, this home is filled with thoughtful upgrades and versatile living spaces. At the heart of the home, the spacious kitchen showcases a huge center island, stainless steel appliances, built-in gas cooktop, granite countertops, butler’s pantry, and a full-sized walk-in pantry. Ample cabinet and counter space make this kitchen both highly functional and ideal for family gatherings and entertaining.

A convenient main-level powder room adds functionality for guests, while upstairs you’ll find a spacious primary suite featuring dual sinks, a standing shower, and a separate soaking tub. The upper level also includes a junior suite, two additional bedrooms that share a full bathroom with dual sinks, and a conveniently located laundry room.

The large upstairs loft provides even more flexibility and is the perfect space for family game nights, movie nights, or a secondary living area. Outside, the backyard offers a low-maintenance retreat with a combination of hardscape, decorative rock, and grass, providing plenty of space to relax and enjoy the outdoors.

Located within a private gated community and surrounded by award-winning schools, shopping, dining, and entertainment, including the nearby Dos Lagos Shopping Center, this home offers an incredible lifestyle in a highly desirable location.

Don’t miss your opportunity to make 25003 Rockston Drive your new home—schedule your private tour today!

results.remarks: Welcome to your opportunity to own an exceptional home in the highly sought-after gated Terramor community, where breathtaking mountain views, resort-style amenities, and modern energy-efficient living come together to create an unmatched lifestyle. Perfectly situated in one of Corona's premier master-planned communities, this beautifully appointed residence offers the space, upgrades, and location you have been searching for. From the moment you step inside, you'll appreciate the bright, open-concept floor plan designed for both comfortable everyday living and effortless entertaining. The spacious great room flows seamlessly into the gourmet kitchen, creating the ideal gathering space for family and friends. The kitchen is truly the heart of the home, featuring an oversized center island with bar seating, stainless steel appliances, abundant cabinetry, generous counter space, and an impressive walk-in pantry. The thoughtfully designed layout continues upstairs where you'll find a spacious loft offering endless flexibility. The outdoor living space is equally impressive. Step onto the expansive backyard deck and take in the stunning mountain views while enjoying your private spa. Whether you're relaxing after a long day, entertaining guests under the stars, or enjoying your morning coffee while watching the sunrise over the surrounding hills, this backyard offers the perfect setting to enjoy Southern California living year-round. Adding tremendous value and long-term savings are the home's premium upgrades, including a PAID OFF solar system that helps reduce monthly utility costs and a whole-house water softener. Living in Terramor means more than owning a beautiful home—it's embracing an incredible lifestyle. Residents enjoy access to an impressive collection of resort-inspired amenities including a sparkling pool, clubhouse, community events and more. The gated community provides both privacy and peace of mind while offering convenient access to shopping, dining, schools, commuter routes, and everything Corona has to offer. Homes with this combination of spectacular mountain views, premium upgrades, paid-off solar, private spa, spacious floor plan, and location within the prestigious Terramor community are in high demand. Whether you're searching for the perfect place to entertain, relax, or simply enjoy a resort-style lifestyle every day, this exceptional property checks all the boxes.

results.remarks:
TRI-LEVEL POOL HOME | FLEXIBLE LAYOUT | VIEW-ORIENTED UPSTAIRS LIVING | $10,000 BUYER CREDIT

Seller is offering **$10,000 toward buyer’s closing costs or rate buydown with an acceptable offer!**

Welcome to 3231 Hannover St, a unique tri-level pool home in the desirable Westport community of Corona. This home offers a flexible hillside-inspired layout that is uncommon for the area and provides excellent separation of living spaces, privacy, and multiple areas to gather or retreat.

The front entry opens to the middle level, where you will find a bedroom that works well as a guest room, office, or private sitting area. From this level, stairs lead both upstairs to the main living areas and downstairs to the lower level.

The upper level is the heart of the home and includes the kitchen, dining area, family room, powder bath, and spacious primary suite. This elevated living area allows for more natural light, neighborhood and mountain views, and convenient access to an exterior stairway leading down to the backyard and pool. The kitchen features bright cabinetry, generous counter space, and an open connection to the dining and family room areas.

The lower level offers additional flexibility with a second living room/family room, two bedrooms, a full bathroom, laundry room, direct garage access, and a sliding glass door leading to the backyard. This setup creates strong separation between the primary suite and secondary bedrooms, and works well for guests, extended stays, older children, roommates, or anyone wanting private space on a separate level.

The backyard is a true highlight, featuring a private pool and spa, patio space, and a relaxing Southern California setting. With multiple indoor living areas, a 3-car garage, good condition, and a layout designed for privacy and versatility, this home offers something different from the typical two-story floor plan.

Certified Pre-Owned Home™: The seller has completed pre-listing home and termite inspections, and inspection reports will be provided for buyer review. The seller is also offering a premium 12-month home warranty for added peace of mind.

If you value privacy, flexible living spaces, separation between bedrooms, elevated living areas, a private pool, and the opportunity to use a $10,000 seller credit toward closing costs or a rate buydown, this unique Corona home is worth seeing in person.
